object: frontier research donor field as an operational stateless reducer
state: The external-donor gate on master can reject under-evidenced promotion requests, but a batch of donors still required manual interpretation to determine the next exact evidence move. That left the research loop executable as validation but not yet convenient as an operating instrument.
delta: Added tools/research-donor-field.mjs, a stateless batch compiler over the existing donor gate.
Each donor is reduced to one evidence lane: UNRESOLVED, RECOVER_PRIMARY, FRAME_TEST, REPLICATE, TRANSFER_TEST, READY, or PARK.
The batch explicitly refuses to self-prioritize; an exact SOURCE_ID must be selected before any next action is compiled.
A selected actionable donor becomes one PREPARE_ONLY action packet and is reduced through the existing FIELD egress reducer to NEXT.
An explicit PARK compiles through the same egress reducer to ARCHIVE.
READY means evidence-eligible for native host review only; donor tooling cannot emit NOW or grant host effect authority.
research-design-loop advanced to 0.3.0 with ordinary-use instructions for batch → lane → explicit selection → one action → evidence → host review → RETURN.
CI now includes the donor-field self-test alongside the donor admission gate.

selftest_contract: batch does not choose its own priority
selected evidence debt compiles to existing FIELD NEXT
READY still requires native host authority

value: Channel research can now be operated as a bounded instrument rather than read as a research note.
Evidence debt is converted into one exact action instead of an accumulating backlog.
The research loop reuses FIELD egress semantics rather than creating a competing workflow state machine.
Selection authority remains outside the batch and host effect authority remains outside the donor field.
authority: Explicit user request on 2026-09-30 to turn the donor field and research loop into something usable while keeping convergence empirical and the reducer move tight.
runtime_changes: Repository CLI/reducer tooling only; no public runtime route.
residue: The compiler intentionally does not fetch transcripts or primary sources itself; source recovery remains a web/recovery operation and exact evidence is fed back into the packet.
The field intentionally does not rank candidates or persist attention.
Actual scientific/host transfer still requires source-specific primary, replica, transfer and host evidence.
next: When a donor is explicitly selected by CURRENT/user context, feed its bounded packet through the compiler, execute only the emitted evidence action, then RETURN; no automatic sequel.
stop: No donor dashboard, watcher, autonomous media backlog, second egress grammar, host authority layer, or transcript store.
